title: Multi-granularity Adaptive Hypergraph Representation Learning via Granular-ball
abstract: arXiv:2609.05574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hypergraph representation learning aims to capture high-order information in graphs by constructing hyperedges that simultaneously connect multiple nodes. These hyperedges adapt to the graph's topological features, facilitating the extraction of high-order relationships at multiple granularities. Most prior work relies on predefined definitions to generate hyperedges, overlooking the diversity in graph topological structures and the multi-granularity characteristics of hyperedges. As a result, this limits their ability to effectively and adaptively discover high-order relationships and efficiently process complex structural information. To address this limitation, we propose a novel framework called \underline{M}ulti-\underline{G}ranularity \underline{H}ypergraph \underline{R}epresentation \underline{L}earning (MGHRL). translated_title: 基于粒球的多粒度自适应超图表示学习
translated_abstract: 超图表示学习旨在通过构造能同时连接多个节点的超边来捕捉图中的高阶信息。这些超边能够适应图的拓扑特征，从而有助于在多个粒度上提取高阶关系。以往的大多数工作依赖预定义的方式来生成超边，忽视了图拓扑结构的多样性以及超边的多粒度特性。因此，这限制了它们有效且自适应地发现高阶关系、高效处理复杂结构信息的能力。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了一个名为多粒度超图表示学习（MGHRL）的新颖框架。MGHRL 引入了一种自适应粒度超图生成策略，该策略可在多个粒度层级上生成超边
tldr: 提出了基于粒球的多粒度超图表示学习框架MGHRL，通过自适应粒度超图生成策略在多个粒度层级上生成超边，从而自适应地发现图中的高阶关系并高效处理复杂结构信息。
en_tdlr: Proposes MGHRL, a novel multi-granularity hypergraph representation learning framework based on granular-balls, which introduces an adaptive granular hypergraph generation strategy to create hyperedges at multiple granularity levels, enabling adaptive discovery of high-order relationships and efficient processing of complex structural information.
